before: Without a w:default paragraph style, unstyled paragraphs resolve to w:docDefaults, and a later duplicate without the flag removes the default.
after: Without a w:default paragraph style, unstyled paragraphs resolve to the last paragraph style named Normal, and the flagged id stays the default across later duplicates. A pasted style never takes the Normal name in a target without a w:default paragraph style.
reason: Only the read-side resolution of the default paragraph style and the names a paste import gives change. Shared nodes, text offsets, operations, and package serialization stay the same, and the resolution never rewrites styles.xml.
